prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: one transparent 2D game sprite, Johnny Castaway Cartoon low-tide lower shore, BACKGRND001.
Primary request: redraw only the exposed lower shore strip from image 1 in the polished hand-drawn Cartoon style of image 2. This is a separate foreground shore layer that overlaps the bottom of the existing island, NOT a whole island.
Input images: image 1 is the authoritative original geometry guide (diagnostic palette, not target colors). Image 2 is the approved existing upper island and supplies warm sand colors, thin dark brown linework, subtle mottled grain and simple light/shadow shapes. Image 3 shows how the original lower strip joins the upper island, for structural understanding only; do not include that upper island or the detached rock in the output.
Composition: output one 1536x1024 RGBA image with a genuinely transparent background. Keep the lower-strip footprint and all meaningful features in the same positions as image 1: within approximately x192..1344 and y400..607. Broad low shallow crescent, taller at far left and far right, concave uneven upper edge, curved lower edge. Preserve the complete left and right tips. Do not enlarge or center-fit the strip independently.
Subject/materials: exposed warm ochre and golden sand bank with shallow irregular eroded facets along its forward face, subtly darker damp sand at the lower edge, illuminated from above left. Keep the small red-orange starfish attached on the left bank in its original position. Keep both tiny pale/red shore objects on the right, matching their source shapes and relative positions. Render those details cleanly but do not add additional props or invent lettering.
The upper overlap boundary should blend into warm pale sand naturally; do not add a heavy dark horizontal seam or a cliff wall. Preserve the low oblique viewpoint and shallow height. Cartoon colors should harmonize closely with image 2, not the fluorescent yellow/olive diagnostic palette in image 1.
Constraints: only the lower shore strip, real alpha transparency elsewhere. No upper island oval, tree, tree shadow, ocean, waves, foam, detached rock, Johnny, horizon, labels, text, frame or backdrop. No baked water or blue strip. No neon yellow/green sand. No dark halo. Preserve reference layout, transparent padding, feature count and orientation.
scope: First low-tide shore draft; no production or native-scene approval.
